mapPicker.title: Set your exact search point
mapPicker.copy: Move the map and select your road, building or neighbourhood to place the marker.

locationPrompt.title: Find care near your live location?
locationPrompt.copy: Allow Swasthya Sarthi to use your device location for accurate nearby hospitals and doctors. Your browser will ask for permission next. If GPS is blocked, Swasthya Sarthi will use your approximate city, and you can still enter another location.
locationPrompt.note: Location is used for this care search. Personal health information remains protected behind sign-in.

hero.title: Find verified doctors and hospitals near you
hero.copy: Search by specialty, symptoms, hospital, or location. Compare source-labelled healthcare information before booking.

trust.title: Know where your healthcare information comes from
trust.copy: Swasthya Sarthi separates provider-confirmed information, public-source listings and community-mapped locations so you can understand what has been verified.
trust.verifiedCopy: Provider and facility verification is shown, never implied.

trust.availabilityCopy: Published Swasthya Sarthi slots are separated from public clinic schedules.
trust.privacyCopy: Browsing is public; personal records remain behind secure sign-in.
trust.discoveryCopy: Search supports cities, districts, and location-based results.
